summary.text: Deb Patterson is a Democratic and Working Families Party state senator from Oregon Senate District 10 who has served since January 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a pastor and healthcare leader.

paragraphs.text: Deb Patterson earned bachelor's and master's degrees in music, a master's degree in health administration from Washington University School of Medicine, and a master's degree and doctorate from Eden Theological Seminary.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was executive director of the International Parish Nurse Resource Center before entering the Legislature.
Patterson assumed office in the Oregon State Senate on January 11, 2021, succeeding Denyc Boles.
In the 2023-2024 session, she chaired the Senate Health Care Committee and was assigned to the Senate Conduct, Housing and Development, and Labor and Business committees.
In her survey, she listed access to healthcare, affordable housing, quality public education and climate action among her legislative priorities.
